name: Nippon Thompson Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Thompson Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells needle roller bearings, linear motion rolling guides, precision positioning tables, and machine components under the IKO brand in Japan, North America, and Asia.
